(Japanese: '''ヤオヘイ''' ''Yaohei'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG068|A Double Dilemma]]''. He was not given a name in the English dub. He and his wife {{OBP|Rose|AG068}} run a greengrocer store in [[North Petalburg]]. Like everyone else in North Petalburg, he is obsessed with [[Petalburg City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Norman]] and his family.

Yaohei claims to have known {{an|May}} and [[Max]] for all of their lives and that he is good friends with Norman. However, he confused {{TRT}} with Norman's family.

He later got into an argument with Rose after the real May and Max showed up, over which ones were the fakes.
